objective: Falsify that repaired Hybrid hard-depth learning improves REAL action selection, physical stability, cold retention and compute over fully trained conventional and smallest adequate controls on unseen challenging source.

difficulty_calibration.deterministic_selection: first candidate in listed order satisfying every admission constraint; if none, STOP_NO_DISCRIMINATING_TASK, never tune on sealed worlds

fitting.optimizer: AdamW for neural arms; closed-form float64 ridge with FITselector-only lambda selection for linear
fitting.convergence: declare best FITselector checkpoint with full training curves; up to 1600 optimizer steps per neural seed; record if exhausted; no retuning on sealed test

policy_trial.shared_action_planner: 1-step evaluate exactly actions 0 and 1 using each trained action-conditioned dynamics model; minimum frozen expected physical stability cost; tie choose 0; no unexecuted effect observation
policy_trial.stability_cost: mean over horizon96 of abs(pole_angle)/0.2095 + 0.1*abs(pole_angular_velocity)/3.5, with each missing step after early termination assigned penalty 2.0
policy_trial.primary: mean per-world stability cost; lower better, 3-seed normalized relative difference to strongest fully trained conventional/policy baseline
policy_trial.cold_retention: export all parameter+optimizer state under exact source pin, cold restore and recompute frozen FIT selector predictions before test (max_abs_diff <= 1e-6)
policy_trial.interference: separate authorized A->B->A protocol with isolated B worlds; test A retention not inferred from same-family state shift

stop_conditions: any failed original source Git/blob/runtime/owner pin or missing signed authorization
any consumed F7 source or seed reused
any unsafely replayed source effect or unknown effect outcome
any calibration criterion not satisfied across all three frozen profiles
any overlapping owner claim or unverified source session identity
any trained baseline unqualified or unequal information/action budgets
any sealed evaluation leaked to training
any budget exceeded; record failure, do not silently expand

authority.allowed_now: write source-neutral proposed contract and synthetic guard tests only
